title: Query all literature sources concurrently
description: Queries OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, and arXiv concurrently for every literature search while isolating source failures and preserving source diagnostics.
changes: Query OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, and arXiv concurrently in interactive and systematic searches.
Do not skip a source when another source already returned enough candidates.
Return per-source success, cache, or failure status with result count and elapsed time.
Merge, deduplicate, and classify results only after all three source requests finish.
Keep the legacy exhaust_sources argument as a no-op for caller compatibility.
